### Borea v0.2.0-dev.5: test build for developers

This pre-release is for the Borea team and developers who want to test v0.2.0 before it is released.
It is not for playing. For normal use, stay on v0.1.0.
v0.2.0 follows right after this build.
Tell us what did not work: [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [GitHub issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/issues)

#### Please test the update once more

This is the first build whose archive unpacks into a folder named `Borea` instead of one with the version in its name.
In dev.4, use "Update now" on the Home banner, or `borea update-self`, and tell us whether Borea restarts as dev.5 in the same folder.
Your folder keeps its name, because Borea updates itself into the folder it runs from.

#### New since v0.2.0-dev.4

- The App archive unpacks into `Borea`, and the CLI archive into `Borea-Cli`. Put that folder where it can stay, for example `%LocalAppData%\Programs\Borea` on Windows or `~/.local/share/Borea` on Linux.

#### How to get the next test builds

With the default update channel, "Stable releases", Borea does not tell you about pre-releases like this one.
To see them, open Settings, General, and set "Update channel for Borea" to "All releases, dev builds included".
"Check for updates at start" must be on, and the change takes effect at the next start.
When v0.2.0 is released, every channel tells you about it.
